title: Fault Tree Analysis for Safety Architectures: Top-Down Decomposition of LLM Failure Modes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: FTA reveals minimal cut sets (smallest failure combinations causing harm), directly informing which defense combinations to prioritize. Clear causal chain from analysis to defense architecture improvements.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a fault tree is a conceptual/analytical exercise. Minimal cut set computation is standard graph analysis. No model training needed. Accessible to CS students familiar with logic gates.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Building a fault tree for one harm category is bounded, but mapping all LLM safety components as nodes and computing cut sets across multiple failure combinations could expand. Needs to be limited to one specific harm scenario.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
